desktop-coast.png.review: Native disclosure and source label are clear. Coasting retains rightward velocity; gravity and net acceleration share concentric endpoints.

coast-vector-diagrams.png.review: Equal physical axes, adaptive velocity rings, fixed acceleration rings, and zero engine force remain readable.

contact-velocity.png.review: The terminal velocity arrow retains its measured downward/rightward direction. Contact forces are omitted with a clear explanation.

recorded-tilted-burn.png.review: Source time, altitude, actual throttle and tilt agree with the recorded state. Motion points right/down while thrust and net acceleration point left/up.

tilted-vector-diagrams.png.review: Both full vector cards and their numerical readings fit without overlap. The lander glyph tilts left with the recorded attitude.

legacy-no-vectors.png.review: Missing recording is explained. No inferred velocity or acceleration diagram is displayed.

phone-320.png.review: Cards stack vertically at 320 px. HTML labels and numbers remain readable, the focus outline is visible, and nothing clips horizontally.

phone-forced-colors.png.review: System colors preserve text, rings, reference axes, native focus and the velocity arrow. Dashed and dotted force patterns retain their distinction.

live-tilted-burn.png.review: The paused live state shows powered rightward acceleration with matching measured throttle, tilt, velocity and mass.

flight-view-webgl.png.review: The live scene and HUD remain visible together. The tilted lander, terrain relief, shadows and drift marker fit the flight view.

scope: Ten native Chromium captures, including 320 px and forced colors. No hardware performance benchmark.
